title: 第15章 法相境九重天第16章 林轩出关冲突
slug: 开局签到帝经我家族独断万古
lines: 亲眼看到这些作恶多端、给家族带来巨大损失的祸害们终于受到应有的惩罚，被就地正法，数十万林家族人无不欢欣鼓舞，激动之情溢于言表，现场响起阵阵雷鸣般的掌声与欢呼声。
尤其是那些曾经深受其害、失去至亲至爱的族人们，此刻心中积压多年的仇恨终于得到释放，泪水如决堤之洪一般奔涌而出，他们喜极而泣，难以自抑。
而此次的审判大会也算是到此结束了……
只不过林家高层们，却并没有立马宣布解散，而是让众人在此尽情的宣泄。
他们知道面对这种事情，族人需要宣泄，也一定要宣泄出来，他们憋了太久了……
而通过此次的事件，林家高层也是意识到以往家族管理方面的不足。
一些细小的地方，和那些底层的族人，家族管理不到位，一些制度也不够完善。
这不能说一定怪谁，怪哪个高层，但确实需要林家高层们进行反思，从而加以改进，拿出确切的解决方案。
而月、年考核制度，便是林家高层的第一个解决方案，后续也会有更多更具体的方案、规定、制度出台，从尽可能的完善家族管理制度，防止此类情况再度发生，危害家族。
众人宣泄了很久，而林家高层也没有着急，而是等到众人宣泄的声音渐渐停下，林天海这才缓缓开口：
“此次审判大会到此结束，诸位族人可自行解散！”
随着林天海这位族长的宣布，本次的审判大会也是正式圆满结束！
随后在众人恭敬的目光中，林长霄等诸位老祖、族老的身影，也是缓缓消失在了虚空之上，回到了天云海中潜修。
而众多林家族人也是纷纷高呼：
“恭送诸位老祖！”
在诸位老祖离开后，众多族人才陆陆续续的离开现场，各自回到自己原来的地方。
第二天
天云海中心区域，只见这里相较于一个月前，此时这里已经多了一座巨大的修炼塔矗立于此，其甚至还偶尔可见有林家族人进出。
而这塔便是林家，为了方便族人于鸿蒙神树功效笼罩范围下修炼，所专门炼制的。
毕竟修炼塔内分成了一个个修炼室，再搭配上阵法，这样可以防止族人修炼、突破时动静太大，从而影响其他族人修炼。
毕竟方圆一里的范围还是太小了，如果有族人突破，很容易就会影响和打扰到其他的族人修炼。
而每个修士修炼被打扰乃是大忌，轻则被打断修炼，前功尽弃；重则可能被反噬让这段时间的努力全都白费，甚至根基受损。
但如果有了这座修炼塔以及搭配阵法，将每个修炼的族人隔开，就可以避免影响到其他人，族人们也就可以安心修炼了。
而这便是林家炼制这座修炼塔的原因，甚至林家还给其起了个名字，造化塔！
而此时从外面看就会发现，此地只有一座造化塔在此，根本没有丝毫鸿蒙神树的影子！
而这是因为此时的鸿蒙神树，已经完全融入了虚空之中，一般人根本无法察觉。
而这也是鸿蒙神树的一个能力，它能让自己完全融入虚空之中，即使是大祖林长霄这样的准帝强者也发现不了丝毫。
而这也可以说是鸿蒙神树的一种自我保护的能力吧，毕竟鸿蒙神树本身并没有太强的攻击能力，如果没有融入虚空等技能，岂不是非常危险？
毕竟诸天万界中想要获得它的强者，简直太多了，甚至可以说没有任何修士强者能抵挡住它的诱惑。
这里可能有人会说，鸿蒙神树还有灵智？
content_en:
Seeing with their own eyes that these scourges who had done many evil things and brought huge losses to the family finally received the punishment they deserved and were executed on the spot, hundreds of thousands of Lin family members were all happy and excited. The excitement was beyond words, and bursts of thunderous applause and cheers rang out at the scene.
Especially those tribesmen who had suffered deeply and lost their loved ones. At this moment, the hatred that had been accumulated in their hearts for many years was finally released. Tears rushed out like a torrent. They cried with joy and could not control themselves.
And this trial conference has come to an end...
However, the senior leaders of the Lin family did not immediately announce their dissolution, but instead allowed everyone to vent their feelings here.
They know that facing this kind of thing, the clan members need to vent, and they must vent it out. They have been holding it in for too long...
Through this incident, the senior leaders of the Lin family also realized the shortcomings in family management in the past.
In some small places, and among those at the bottom of the clan, family management is not in place, and some systems are not perfect enough.
We can’t say who is to blame or which senior executive is to blame, but it does require the senior executives of the Lin family to reflect on it, improve it, and come up with exact solutions.
The monthly and annual assessment system is the first solution for the top management of the Lin family. More and more specific plans, regulations, and systems will be introduced in the future to improve the family management system as much as possible to prevent this kind of situation from happening again and harming the family.
Everyone vented for a long time, and the top management of the Lin family did not rush. Instead, they waited until the venting gradually stopped, and then Lin Tianhai slowly spoke:
"This trial meeting is over, all tribesmen can disband on your own!"
With the announcement of Lin Tianhai, the patriarch, this trial meeting has officially come to a successful conclusion!
Then, under the respectful gaze of everyone, the figures of Lin Changxiao and other ancestors and clan elders slowly disappeared into the void and returned to the sea of ​​​​sky clouds to practice cultivation.
And many Lin family members also shouted:
"Congratulations to all ancestors!"
After the ancestors left, many tribesmen left the scene one after another and returned to their original places.
…
the next day
In the central area of Tianyunhai, there is now a huge cultivation tower standing here compared to a month ago. People from the Lin family can even be seen coming in and out occasionally.
This tower was specially made by the Lin family in order to facilitate the people of the clan to practice under the influence of the Hongmeng Sacred Tree.
After all, the training tower is divided into training rooms, coupled with formations. This can prevent the tribesmen from making too much noise when practicing and breaking through, thus affecting the cultivation of other tribesmen.
After all, the radius of one mile is still too small. If a clan member breaks through, it will easily affect and disturb the cultivation of other clan members.
It is a big taboo for every monk to be interrupted in his practice. At the very least, the practice may be interrupted and all previous efforts will be wasted; at the most serious degree, it may be backfired, making all the efforts during this period in vain, and even damaging the foundation.
But if we have this training tower and the matching formations to separate each practicing tribesman, we can avoid affecting other people, and the tribesmen can practice with peace of mind.
And this is the reason why the Lin family refined this cultivation tower. The Lin family even gave it a name, the Tower of Creation!
At this time, looking from the outside, you will find that there is only one Creation Tower here, and there is no shadow of the Hongmeng Sacred Tree at all!
And this is because the Hongmeng Sacred Tree at this time has completely integrated into the void, and ordinary people cannot detect it at all.
And this is also an ability of the Hongmeng Sacred Tree. It can completely integrate itself into the void, and even a quasi-emperor like the Great Ancestor Lin Changxiao cannot detect it at all.
And this can also be said to be a self-protection ability of the Hongmeng Sacred Tree. After all, the Hongmeng Sacred Tree itself does not have a strong attack ability. If it is not integrated with skills such as void, wouldn't it be very dangerous?
After all, there are simply too many strong people in the world who want to obtain it. It can even be said that no strong monk can resist its temptation.
Some people here may say, does the Hongmeng Sacred Tree still have spiritual intelligence?
